description: Update backtester to accept MT5 tick data format (time_msc,bid,ask,...) and auto-detect data format. Convert ticks to 1-minute OHLC candles internally. Update config/settings.yaml.
steps: Modify backtester.py load_data() to auto-detect tick data vs OHLC data based on column headers
Add tick-to-OHLC conversion using bid price (or mid price) to 1-minute candles
Handle time_msc (millisecond epoch) to datetime conversion
Create config/settings.yaml with backtest section pointing to the tick data file
Add tests for tick data loading and conversion
acceptance_criteria: Backtester accepts tick data format with columns time_msc,bid,ask,last,volume,flags,flags_str,volume_real
Tick data is converted to 1-minute OHLC candles using mid price (bid+ask)/2
time_msc millisecond epoch timestamps are properly converted to datetime
OHLC data format still works as before (auto-detection)
config/settings.yaml created with correct backtest configuration
All existing tests pass plus new tick data tests
findings: Successfully implemented tick data support in backtester. The load_data() method now auto-detects format by checking column headers: if time_msc/bid/ask columns are present it treats data as tick data and converts to 1min OHLC using mid price; otherwise falls back to standard OHLC parsing. time_msc (millisecond epoch) is converted via pd.to_datetime(unit='ms', utc=True) then timezone info stripped for uniform downstream handling. Created config/settings.yaml with backtest section. All 114 tests pass (106 existing + 8 new).
